<!-- Introduction -->
::: {.intro-section}
Nice to meet you. I am Youngjun Park, and I study cities.<br>
I work on how people's activity, behavior, and opinion can reach the way cities get planned,<br>
and on how far what surfaces that way can be trusted.

Toward that question, my work divides into four:<br>
1) **Research** grounded in statistics and data,<br>
2) **Design** in architecture and urban design,<br>
3) **Programming** that builds AI agent systems,<br>
4) And **teaching** urban design and urban data analysis.
:::
